## What

Brief description of the change.

## Why

The problem this solves, or the decision behind it. Link an ADR if one applies.

## Checks

- [ ] `pnpm verify` clean
- [ ] Checked at narrow, laptop and wide viewports
- [ ] Animation checked with reduced motion enabled
- [ ] Keyboard path checked: every control reachable, focus ring visible
- [ ] No new third-party origin, or the Content Security Policy in `scripts/bundle-pages.mjs` updated with it
- [ ] No new personal data stored without a matching note in `docs/architecture.md`

## Notes

Anything a reviewer should look at closely, or a known trade-off being accepted.
